constraints: English only, no emojis; plan files under 400 lines; Python files under 1000 lines.

Strict typing enforced by tools/typelint.py (TL001-TL010), ruff ANN/PGH and ty 0.0.85; no Any/object/dict/Mapping/TypedDict, no **kwargs or ** unpacking, no # type: ignore or # ty: ignore; the only per-file-ignores are src/telescreen/core/json.py and src/telescreen_police_sdk/_json.py.
Never persist, log, index, notify or return raw sensitive values; masked values and keyed HMAC fingerprints only; monitored content scanned transiently.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration tests marked integration and skipped unless TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL are set.
No plan edits pyproject.toml, uv.lock, mise.toml, .gitignore, README.md or src/web; dependency or shared-file changes go through Reconciliation requests and serial finalization.
Police SDK never imports telescreen.*; the Bureau never imports telescreen_police_sdk except tests/contract/test_bureau_contract.py.
Accepted plans p01-p10, p22, p23 are not re-implemented; their files change only through serial finalization with a review call-out.

All plans of a wave share one working directory and branch: write only inside writePaths, no git mutation commands, per-edit fresh read plus sha256 before/after logging (impl-plans/conventions.md section 2); verification shells start with set -o pipefail and export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
Resume rule: verify in-tree code against the plan, repair gaps, do not rewrite working code from scratch.
reviewContext.userProblem: The owner needs Telescreen, a Sentry-style monitor for sensitive-data retention violations (credentials, PII, confidential data) across Slack, Google Drive/Docs/Sheets, GitHub and custom collectors/Police, with a Reporting Bureau hub, durable DB-backed incident/AI workflow engine, outbound DLP, searchable hash-chained audit and an AI assistant, never storing raw sensitive values. Run A completes the 12 remaining backend plans on top of the 12 accepted plans committed at c81fe52.
requiredOutcomes: p11: standalone Police SDK (pull worker, push webhook/ASGI helper with HMAC signature verification, sweep partition/scan_shard handlers, example private-DB police, n8n push example) with contract tests; no telescreen.* import.
p15: append-only hash-chained audit log with verification, Meilisearch indexing behind IndexGuard, audit and search APIs.

p16: Sentry-like issue grouping (source + resource locator + rule class), first/last seen, times_seen, status transitions incl. regressed and auto-resolve, push ingestion API that re-guards pushed findings.
p17: notifications (Slack, email) behind an outbound DLP gate that masks or blocks raw values, audited.
p18: evidence upload (text and images) scanned and rejected on PII/credentials, fail closed.

p19: Bureau police service and API: register, claim, heartbeat, result for pull mode; signed webhook dispatch and signed callback for push mode behind PoliceGateway; Bureau-side contract test against the SDK.
p20: collectors core service, registry, scheduler (event/schedule/both), rescanner, police and sweep integration, collectors API.
p21: Slack collector (Events API signing verification, scheduled scans, sweep).
p24: durable workflow engine (runs, steps, transitions, SKIP LOCKED queue, leases/retries, timers, scheduler, human tasks with SLA escalation, triggers) and its APIs.
p25: detect, ai_agent, notify and police_verify step executors.

p26: map-reduce sweeps (map step, streaming partition, global max_concurrency dispatch, 429 backpressure, crash-safe no-duplicate shards, count-only reduce with removal reconciliation, 10,000-shard concurrency-cap test).
p27: assistant MCP server and agent chat with masked tool outputs.
Serial finalization passes full-repository ruff format/check, typelint, ty, offline pytest and uv build.
nonGoals: src/web and UI plans p12-ui-issues, p13-ui-workflows, p14-ui-ops (reworked to design-docs/specs/design-ui-sentry.md in run B).
Re-implementing accepted plans p01-p10, p22, p23.
OIDC SSO (deferred; v1 uses bearer API tokens).
designDecisionsAndRationale: Self-built durable workflow engine and map-reduce on PostgreSQL instead of Airflow/n8n/Kestra: human-in-the-loop steps, send-back, evidence gates and DB-visible progress must stay raw-data-free (design-workflow-engine.md, design-map-reduce-sweeps.md, notes.md).
Bureau and Police couple only through the versioned HTTP+JSON contract with pull and push transports behind PoliceGateway, so n8n and other languages can implement Police (design-police-contract.md).
Raw values are never persisted; only masked representations and keyed HMAC fingerprints; IndexGuard and DLP gate add defense in depth (design-masking.md).
Run A splits the s319 wave 4 into waves A1 and A2 of six plans each so no wave-outcome prompt nears the context limit that stopped s319.
The SDK asgi.py TL005 per-file-ignore is not pre-approved (architecture.md section 6, design-police-contract.md); p11 must comply without it or raise a reviewed Reconciliation request.
intentionalTradeoffs: All wave plans share one working directory and branch with disjoint writePaths instead of worktrees; serial finalization re-runs the full gates to catch cross-plan breakage.
Shared files (pyproject.toml, uv.lock, accepted-plan files) change only through serially applied Reconciliation requests, at the cost of slower dependency changes.
Plans already reviewed at s319 (p15, p18, p21, p25) are verified rather than rewritten, accepting that their review predates run A.
supportedEdgeCases: Police lease expiry and re-claim, replayed or stale webhook signatures rejected by the nonce store and replay window, a resource counted as failed whenever its handler raises.
Map-reduce crash recovery without duplicate shards, 429 backpressure, removal reconciliation in reduce.
Issue regression after resolve and auto-resolve when a later scan no longer finds the item.
Evidence images scanned by the vision LLM, fail closed when it is unavailable.
Notifications containing raw values masked or blocked by the DLP gate; tests assert raw sample secrets never appear in DB rows, logs, index documents, notifications or API responses.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond integration-marked tests skipped offline.
UI rendering and docker compose deployment behavior (run B).
